criteria.description: The bulk of the questions ask about specific PAST behavior (e.g. 'tell me about the last time you…') anchored to a real recent instance, rather than opinions or hypotheticals.
Questions are open and non-leading — they do NOT smuggle in the proposed solution or invite agreement (no 'would you use…', 'do you think X would help', 'how often do you wish').
States what the research is trying to learn / the decision it informs, and the questions ladder to it.
Includes follow-up probes to go deeper (e.g. 'what did you do next?', 'why did that matter?') rather than a flat one-pass list.
Avoids pitching/validating the AI auto-reply solution during discovery; any solution reaction is deferred/fenced to the end, not mixed into the behavioral questions.
Seeks the user's current workarounds and the emotional/trigger context, not just surface facts.
